title: Buffalo and Erie County Naval & Military Park Museum

services.name: Hours & Admission
services.desc: Plan your visit to the largest inland Naval Park in the United States! The Buffalo Naval Park offers year-round experiences including self-guided tours, guided tours, events and more. Office staff work regular business hours throughout the year on Monday-Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Park Hours Late March - April: Open Wednesday - Sunday10:00 AM - 5:00 PM Last ticket to access the ships is sold at 4:00 PM May - September:Open 7 Days a Week 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM Last ticket to access the ships is sold at 4:00 PM October:Open 7 Days a Week 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM Last ticket to access the ships is sold at 3:00 PMNovember: Open Saturday - Sunday before Thanksgiving and on Veterans Day (Nov. 11)

services.name: Guided Tour
services.desc: Any school field trip (10 or more people) can take advantage of touring the ships at a special group rate. School field trips must be booked in advance. Two time slots are available: 10:00AM or 12:30PM (some exceptions apply). Tours run for approximately 2 hours. Pricing: Adult: $18; Student: $10 For eligible groups, one (1) complimentary chaperone ticket will be issued for every ten (10) paid students.
